name: Kurenai no Tsuki
source:
Kouya, a rookie detective, is walking deep inside the forest. It was two weeks ago, a hand of an unidentified creature washed up on the shore of a river. Hard and thick skin, bristle like an animal, thick fingers and sharp nails, it was not a human's hand. Also, there was a jewel ring on the ring finger. 

This mysterious story was featured in a magazine and caught people's attention. Days later, the police found that it was a woman's hand, who had been missing for a month. She went missing when she played golf with her friends nearby. The police confirmed she was attacked by a stray dog, but couldn't explain why the hand looked so differently. They tried to close the case, but her husband wasn't convinced. He didn't want to believe his wife was a monster. He decided to ask a detective to investigate the case, that's why Kouya is now roaming around deep inside the forest.

It is getting dark, but he doesn't know where he is now. Just when he feels dizzy, he hears someone's voice. Is that auditory hallucination? He hears a girl's voice this time. "I've been saved!" But he accidentally falls down a waterfall. When he regains his consciousness, he finds himself lying in the bed. He looks around and finds three girls. "Are you alright?" "Well, did you save me?" "Yes, I and my older sister carried you all the way here." Their mother says to him, "I'm relieved to see you getting well. But you must marry either of my daughters, Sunao or Hiori."

He doesn't know what she means. A mysterious hand bitten off by someone, a small village deep inside the forest, marriage to a miko, Kouya's fate is led to unexpected direction after he meets these two girls...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
新人侦探荒野正在森林深处行走。两周前，一只身份不明生物的手被河水冲上岸。那只手皮肤坚硬厚实，生有动物般的刚毛，手指粗壮、指甲尖锐，显然不属于人类。无名指上却戴着一枚镶有宝石的戒指。

这桩怪事经杂志报道后引起广泛关注。数日后，警方确认那是一名失踪已有一个月的女性的手。她与朋友在附近打高尔夫时失踪。警方认定她遭到野狗袭击，却无法解释那只手为何会变成如此模样，于是试图草草结案。她的丈夫无法接受这种说法，也不愿相信妻子是怪物，便委托侦探调查。正因如此，荒野如今才会在密林深处四处搜寻。

天色渐暗，荒野却已经不知道自己身在何处。就在他感到头晕目眩时，耳边突然传来人声。那是幻听吗？这一次，他听见了少女的声音。“得救了！”然而，他却意外跌下瀑布。恢复意识后，荒野发现自己躺在床上，身边站着三名少女。
“你没事吧？”
“是你们救了我吗？”
“对，我和姐姐一路把你抬到这里。”
她们的母亲对他说：“看见你恢复健康，我就放心了。不过，你必须迎娶我的女儿素直或日织中的一人。”

荒野完全不明白她在说什么。被某种东西咬断的神秘手掌、深藏在森林里的小村庄、与巫女成婚…遇见两名少女后，荒野的命运被引向了意想不到的方向。
